1_c2_targets.howC2IsFormed: scripts/run_weekly_passive_first_replay.py L396-408: for each 21-session block, stock = sealed standalone row["weights"] (CHAMPION selector ALPHA_RANK_PER_DOWNSIDE_RISK = pipeline/kelly_portfolio.SELECTION_METHOD); C2 target = stock + {069500.KS: max(0, 1 - sum(stock))}, so cash = 0; valued by replay_valuation.ValuationData.window over RC.sessions(date,endDate,"UNION") on frozen replay-v16 closes with 069500.KS re-marked by the Phase C corrected series (L360-363); buy-and-hold drift inside the block (terminalWeights); account() L161-195 chains blocks, charging _leg_cost on |target - previous terminalWeights| for every ticker incl. 069500.KS at block start; NAV = prior*(1-cost)*dailyGrossNav. C2 per-block targets are therefore fully DERIVABLE (deterministically) from the standalone file but not stored as a separate record.
